name: NABA Milano
description: Founded in 1980 in Milano, Italy, NABA-Nuova Accademia Di Belle Arti Milano is one of the best private design schools in Italy. In the 2011–2012 academic year, it started to offer English-medium university programs for the first time. Every year, approximately 2000 students from 60 different nationalities receive education at NABA. As a part of NABA Laureate International Universities training group, it has a wide international network.
